name: My Zypp Stikks 1g Infused Preroll - Super Skittlez
description:
Infused and ready to spark. The My Zypp Stikks Super Skittlez is a 1-gram infused pre-roll packed with quality flower for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, just light it and go.

Super Skittlez brings that candy-shop favorite: sweet mixed fruit and sugary berry notes up front with a smooth, tropical finish.

1G infused pre-roll — quality flower infused for extra potency
Signature Super Skittlez flavor — sweet mixed fruit and sugary berry with a tropical finish
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

My Zypp Stikks Super Skittlez is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
